To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
calcium plays a key role in the function (but not production) of A. pleupropneumoniae cytolytic proteins.
calcium plays an integral, but not a regulatory, role in secretion of the cytolysis of Actinobacte
(1) the cytolysin activity and binding of A. pleuropleumoniae to target cells are calcium dependent and (2) the production of the cytolysis is calcium independent.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of calcium in the function and secretion of A. pleupneumoniae cytoplasmic membrane-associated cytolysins.
the characterization and regulation of cytolysins produced by Actinobacillius pleuropneumonie.
the production, secretion, and function of the cytolysis of Actinobasillus pleuropneunomiae.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cytolysin activity of Actinobasculas pleuropneumonie is dependent on calcium.
the presence of calcium is required for the activity (but not secretion) of A. pleuropeunoniae cytolysis.
the hemolysins of Actino-bacillus pleu-pneumoniae are secreted independently of calcium, but calcium is necessary for their binding and activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

A. pleuupneumoniae cytoplasmic proteins (cytolysins) are secreted in the absence of calcium, bind to target cell membranes in the presence of extracellular calcium, and are activated for cytolysis in the presence of both extracellular and intracellular calcium.
calcium is a requirement for the function but not production of A. pleuropneumoniaie cytolysins.
the presence of calcium is required for the activity of cytolysins I,II,III, but not for the secretion of cytolysis I,II, or the production of cytolysisin III.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of calcium is required for binding of cytolysins to the target cell and not for the secretion of cytolysinin culture medium by A. pleupropneumoniae.
the hemolytic activity of A. Pleuropneumonia cytolysin 1 is dependent on calcium.
calcium plays an important role in the binding and activity of the Actinobacilluss pleuropneumonae cytolysins, but not in the secretion of the cytolysis proteins.
